sections.name: File setup, GeometryRow
sections.title: Imports and the stored row shape
sections.what: Brings in database access, the map data checker and the type definitions, and describes how one geometry row is stored.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the database row format explicit.

sections.name: syntheticGeometry, oldHeroGeometry, correctedHeroGeometry, oldControlGeometry, correctedControlGeometry
sections.title: Seed shapes and their builder
sections.what: Builds a seed shape for a parcel and holds the corrected and older versions of the hero and control boundary polygons. Each seed is marked synthetic and uses a fixed timestamp.
sections.why: Likely reason: the older versions let the update step recognise and replace only the seeded data.
sections.watch_out: The timestamp is fixed, so every seed appears to have been created at the same moment.

sections.name: seedGeometries
sections.title: Seed list for hero and control
sections.what: Lists the two seed parcel shapes, the hero and the control, using the corrected versions.
sections.why: Likely reason: this list is what gets loaded into storage.
sections.watch_out: Only the hero and control cases are seeded, so any other case gets no shape.

sections.name: fromRow
sections.title: Turns a stored row into a shape
sections.what: Reads one database row, checks the stored map data and rebuilds the full geometry object with its coordinate system and synthetic labels.
sections.why: Likely reason: data read back from storage is checked before the app uses it.
sections.watch_out: Corrupted stored text makes this step fail, so a bad row can stop a parcel from loading.

sections.name: ParcelGeometryService, parcelGeometryService
sections.title: Geometry storage service
sections.what: Makes sure seed rows exist, reads the shape for one case and parcel with its khata and khesra numbers, and resets one case to its seed in a single transaction.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps seeding, reading and resetting in one place so the demo starts in a known state.
sections.watch_out: The update step only changes rows whose stored shape still matches the older version, so manually edited rows are left alone.

summary: Stores and returns the mapped boundary shape for each demo parcel, and updates older seeded shapes to the corrected version.
purpose: Gives the parcel view a calculated boundary to compare against the recorded areas.
why: Likely reason: the corrected demo shapes are written into storage so the same result shows each time, and only rows still holding the old shape are changed.
how: Holds fixed seed shapes for the hero and control parcels, in corrected form and in the older form used for the update check. The ensureSeedGeometries method runs before reads: it inserts missing seed rows and rewrites hero or control rows that still match the old shape. The getForParcel method reads the row for one case and parcel, parses its stored shape and adds the khata and khesra numbers. The resetSeedGeometry method replaces all rows for one case with its seed in a single transaction.
inputs: A case identifier, a parcel identifier, a khata number and an optional khesra number.
outputs: A parcel geometry object, or nothing if no row exists.
risks: Reading the geometry can change stored rows automatically. Reset deletes every geometry row for the case before reinserting the seed.
debug: If an area looks wrong, check the stored geometry row for that case and compare it with the seed shapes. If nothing returns, check the parcel identifier matches. After a reset, the row is recreated from the seed.
